svg.title: The honesty layer — how much to trust (solid / heuristic / overstated)
svg.desc: Three layers. Solid (textbook/peer-reviewed): greek definitions and the three flows, dealers net short vol (GPP), expiration pinning (NPP), dealer gamma's intraday effect (Barbon and Buraschi), 0DTE about 59 percent. Framework (heuristic): vanna rally, charm's OPEX drift, the GEX regime map — not a directional forecast. Overstated, to avoid: dealers dominate the market, a post-OPEX window of weakness, one vendor's GEX as ground truth, applying it to single stocks, the monthly OPEX effect unchanged.
svg.text: The honesty layer — how much to trust
Greek definitions & the three flows / dealers net short vol (GPP) / expiration pinning (NPP)
vanna rally / charm's OPEX drift / the GEX regime map — not a directional forecast
dealers dominate the market / a reliable post-OPEX "window of weakness" / a vendor's GEX as truth
/ applying it to single stocks / the monthly-OPEX effect unchanged
The math is solid, the positioning is inferred, the impact claims span a wide range.
